snippet.title: CUBEN 1st Trailer (English)
snippet.description:
A single path stretches before you. Guided by a mysterious figure, you follow the road ahead. "CUBEN" is an addictive puzzle roguelite game that will captivate your mind. Dive into innovative puzzles, use items and allies to defeat enemies, and advance through challenging levels.

CUBEN
Scheduled to be released in 2025
